title: The Branch
lead: A name in Jeremiah and Zechariah for a king the LORD will raise up from David's family after the failure of the royal line (Jeremiah 23:5-6; Jeremiah 33:15-16; Zechariah 3:8; Zechariah 6:12). The Hebrew tsemach means a sprout; the Greek translates it "dawn" (anatole, Luke 1:78). Jewish and Christian tradition read it of the Messiah.
